# Activity Vault

The all-in-one activity archive for teachers and after-school program teachers.
Hundreds of real, classic, public-domain activity concepts — filterable by age, time,
group size, materials, and category. Plan-my-week planner. Printable one-page cards.

## Categories
- Seasons: 34 activities — Activities that ride the turning year — fall leaves, winter making, spring planting, summer play.
- Holidays: 38 activities — Festive projects and games for the days the whole group looks forward to.
- Crafts: 66 activities — Hands-on making: fold it, paint it, build it, take it home.
- STEM: 45 activities — Experiments, engineering challenges, and satisfying science demos.
- PE & Movement: 43 activities — Run, jump, dance — activities that burn off the wiggles.
- Team & Community: 41 activities — Turn a group into a crew: cooperation, trust, and belonging.
- Icebreakers: 27 activities — First-day friendly: learn names, laugh, and loosen up fast.
- Outdoor: 37 activities — Fresh-air activities for fields, playgrounds, and nature walks.
- Rainy Day: 30 activities — Stuck inside? These keep a roomful of kids happy without a gym.
- Quiet & Focus: 50 activities — Wind-down worthy: calm, creative, individual or small-group.
- Music & Rhythm: 7 activities — Drums, shakers, rhythm games, and songs — make some noise.

## API — start at api/v1/index.json (self-describing manifest)
- api/v1/index.json — api manifest
- api/v1/activities.json — full activity library
- api/v1/categories.json — category definitions
- api/v1/filters.json — filter configuration
- api/v1/skills.json — skills registry

## Skills
- skills/activity-finder.md — Find the right activity fast using age, time, group size, and materials-on-hand filters.
- skills/halloween-party-planner.md — Turn party constraints into a timed station-rotation plan from seasonal activities.
- skills/icebreaker-chooser.md — Pick first-day and new-group icebreakers matched to group size and shyness level.
- skills/no-prep-rescue.md — Grab-and-go activities that need zero prep and zero (or near-zero) materials.
- skills/outdoor-play-picker.md — Pick the right outdoor activity for the space, weather, and energy level you have.
- skills/quiet-focus-picker.md — Pick wind-down and calm-focus activities to land a loud group or fill a calm slot.
- skills/rainy-day-rescue.md — Instant indoor plan when the weather kills outdoor time.
- skills/stem-demo-picker.md — Pick the right STEM demo or engineering challenge for the age group and time available.
- skills/sub-tub-rescue.md — Build a print-ready substitute-teacher emergency plan for any grade band and time gap.
- skills/week-planner.md — Build a no-repeat week of activities from days, slots, and constraints.

## Tools
- sub.html — Sub Tub: the substitute-teacher rescue kit.
  Pick grade band, minutes to fill, materials on hand, location —
  generates a sequenced print-ready emergency plan plus a 'Dear sub' note template.
- party.html — Halloween Class-Party Planner.
  Pick class size, minutes, stations, and budget — generates a timed station-rotation
  plan from seasonal activities, plus a setup list and a print-ready run sheet.
- planner.html — Plan-my-week planner: days, slots per day, and filters →
  a no-repeat week of activities with a print-ready sheet.
- api.html — API docs with a Try-the-API console (endpoint picker, fetch, pretty JSON).

## Docs
- API.md — full API reference
- PIPELINE.md — how the library grows
- AGENT.md — how an agent uses this archive: endpoints, example requests,
  end-to-end workflows (filtering, party planning, week planning)
